checks: The common object is the actual nonzero complete complex space C_0(N,C), with actual bounded shift and finite-rank truncated shift operators.

Finite coefficient lists implement every displayed polynomial, including constant and zero polynomials. The phase test proves eventual exact norm equality on the whole ambient space.

The actual bounded-operator algebra spectrum is used; finite two-sided resolvents, all model spectra equal to {0}, the limit spectral point 1 and absence of any approximating spectral sequence are proved.
The extra polynomial-norm hypothesis is fully verified; the rubric accepts all legal complete counterexamples and does not require the reference witness or whole shift spectrum.
